verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas exposes a scriptable Editor API and REST API (playcanvas-docs-9, playcanvas-docs-30, playcanvas-docs-27) plus an official MCP server for AI assistants, but the MCP server explicitly requires 'an open PlayCanvas Editor session' (playcanvas-docs-6, playcanvas-probe-rt-1), meaning automations are tied to an active interactive session rather than running fully autonomously in the background. missing for 10: evidence of scheduled/unattended background jobs or agent runs without a live editor session, independent confirmation of autonomous multi-step automation.
